# v2026.11.8

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.11.8.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.11.8.md).

This release covers **3 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- Flow reads its Xero copy again from the start, one time, so old invoices get their Reference and line text. ([#509](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/509))
- Jobs match a Xero invoice by the patient in its Reference, so twin jobs of one client pair by patient. ([#509](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/509))
- Every Send asks Xero itself for an invoice with the same Reference before it makes one. ([#510](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/510))
- A job that a non-chargeable rule matches drafts to Non-chargeable even with an unmapped line, unknown tax or an old report. ([#510](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/510))

## Changes

- A manager or an agent can read one invoice from Xero itself: `POST /api/xero/import/<InvoiceID>/read`. ([#509](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/509))
- The Flow skill says: read the record in the source system before you reconcile or repair a sync. ([#509](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/509))

## Fixes

- Old invoices in the Xero copy had no Reference, so jobs could not match them by patient. ([#509](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/509))
- Send no longer trusts the Xero copy alone, so it cannot make a second invoice for work Xero already billed. ([#510](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/510))
- Non-chargeable jobs no longer stay Pending on price, tax or report checks. ([#510](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/510))
